params.caption:
🚨 s1mple's BC.Game is OUT of PGL Major Singapore 2026!

Chinggis Warriors eliminated BC.Game 2-1 (Ancient 13-11, Dust2 13-6 BC.Game, Nuke 13-10), sending Oleksandr "s1mple" Kostyliev's squad home 0-3 — without a single map series win at this Major.

BC.Game roster: s1mple, Magisk, asap, Senzu, mzinho
Chinggis Warriors roster: cool4st, tikuak, fury5k, sk0R, ROUX

After the loss, Magisk told reporters the team "didn't deliver" and needs to find solutions.

🕐 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 20:02 GMT+3

📰 Sources: HLTV

👥 Follow: x.com/s1mpleO | x.com/HLTVorg | x.com/pglesports

💬 Can s1mple's BC.Game bounce back at the next Major, or is a roster change coming?

#CS2 #PGLMajor #Esports #s1mple #GamingNews
